title: American Places – Gettysburg, Pennsylvania
summary: АНУ-ын Иргэний дайны томоохон тулалдаан болсон Геттисбург хот, түүний музей.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Nancy Steinbach, Ashley Thompson, Mario Ritter Jr. · VOA Learning English

questions.prompt: When did the battle of Gettysburg begin?
questions.explain: "The battle of Gettysburg began on July 1, 1863" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: What is special about the cyclorama painting?
options: It surrounds the people looking at it
It was painted by President Lincoln himself
It shows a large map of Washington, D.C.
questions.explain: "This kind of artwork completely surrounds the people looking at it" гэж бичсэн. Өөрөөр хэлбэл зураг үзэгчдийг бүх талаас нь тойрдог.

questions.prompt: How long did Lincoln speak at Gettysburg?
questions.explain: "Lincoln spoke for just two minutes" гэж бичсэн. Энэ илтгэлийг "The Gettysburg Address" гэдэг.
